'''Arboreal octopuses''' were a breed of [[Octopus/Legends|octopus]] native to [[Cholganna/Legends|Cholganna]]. They were often hunted by [[Nexu/Legends|nexu]]. Unlike most [[Cephalopod/Legends|cephalopods]], they dwelt in [[Tree/Legends|trees]] rather than in [[Water/Legends|water]]. As such, they also possessed a substance similar to fur, as well as webbing near the arms.
